```{r}
calc_agreement <- function(df, llm_name) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Dimension) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(human) & !is.na(.data[[llm_name]])),
      pearson_r = cor(human, .data[[llm_name]], use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson"),
      spearman_r = cor(human, .data[[llm_name]], use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman"),
      mean_diff = mean(.data[[llm_name]] - human, na.rm = TRUE),
      mae = mean(abs(.data[[llm_name]] - human), na.rm = TRUE),
      rmse = sqrt(mean((.data[[llm_name]] - human)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(LLM = llm_name)
}

res_human_vs_llm <- bind_rows(
  calc_agreement(pair_human_llm, "deepseek_V3.2"),
  calc_agreement(pair_human_llm, "Chat_GPT_5.4"),
  calc_agreement(pair_human_llm, "Claude_Sonnet_4.6")
)

res_human_vs_llm
```

```{r}
icc_a1_fast <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  n <- length(x)
  k <- 2
  
  if (n < 3) return(NA_real_)
  
  dat <- cbind(x, y)
  
  row_means <- rowMeans(dat)
  col_means <- colMeans(dat)
  grand_mean <- mean(dat)
  
  ss_rows <- k * sum((row_means - grand_mean)^2)
  ss_cols <- n * sum((col_means - grand_mean)^2)
  ss_total <- sum((dat - grand_mean)^2)
  ss_error <- ss_total - ss_rows - ss_cols
  
  ms_rows <- ss_rows / (n - 1)
  ms_cols <- ss_cols / (k - 1)
  ms_error <- ss_error / ((n - 1) * (k - 1))
  
  icc <- (ms_rows - ms_error) / (ms_rows + (k - 1) * ms_error + k * (ms_cols - ms_error) / n)
  as.numeric(icc)
}
```

```{r}
boot_icc <- function(x, y, B = 1000, conf = 0.95, seed = 123) {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 3) {
    return(data.frame(
      n = n,
      ICC = NA_real_,
      ICC_lwr = NA_real_,
      ICC_upr = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  icc_obs <- icc_a1_fast(x, y)
  
  boot_vals <- replicate(B, {
    idx <- sample.int(n, size = n, replace = TRUE)
    icc_a1_fast(x[idx], y[idx])
  })
  
  alpha <- (1 - conf) / 2
  
  data.frame(
    n = n,
    ICC = icc_obs,
    ICC_lwr = as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = alpha, na.rm = TRUE)),
    ICC_upr = as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = 1 - alpha, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}
```

```{r}
calc_icc_boot <- function(df, llm_name, B = 1000, conf = 0.95, seed = 123) {
  dims <- unique(df$Dimension)
  
  out <- lapply(seq_along(dims), function(i) {
    d <- dims[i]
    
    tmp <- df %>%
      filter(Dimension == d)
    
    res <- boot_icc(
      x = tmp$human,
      y = tmp[[llm_name]],
      B = B,
      conf = conf,
      seed = seed + i
    )
    
    data.frame(
      Dimension = d,
      LLM = llm_name,
      n = res$n,
      ICC = res$ICC,
      ICC_lwr = res$ICC_lwr,
      ICC_upr = res$ICC_upr
    )
  })
  
  bind_rows(out)
}
```

```{r}
icc_human_vs_llm_boot <- bind_rows(
  calc_icc_boot(pair_human_llm, "Chat_GPT_5.4", B = 1000),
  calc_icc_boot(pair_human_llm, "deepseek_V3.2", B = 1000),
  calc_icc_boot(pair_human_llm, "Claude_Sonnet_4.6", B = 1000)
)
```

```{r}
plot_icc_nature <- function(data, llm_name,
                            xlim = c(-0.1, 0.8),
                            highlight_cut = 0.50) {
  
  df_plot <- data %>%
    filter(LLM == llm_name) %>%
    mutate(
      Dimension = str_wrap(as.character(Dimension), width = 8)
    ) %>%
    arrange(ICC) %>%
    mutate(
      Dimension = factor(Dimension, levels = Dimension),
      Highlight = ifelse(ICC >= highlight_cut, "ICC ≥ 0.50", "ICC < 0.50")
    )
  
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = ICC, y = Dimension)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey70") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey55") +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(xmin = ICC_lwr, xmax = ICC_upr),
      height = 0,
      linewidth = 0.6,
      color = "grey35"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = Highlight),
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.8,
      stroke = 0.4,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("ICC ≥ 0.50" = "black", "ICC < 0.50" = "white")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = xlim,
      breaks = seq(0, 0.8, by = 0.2),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Human vs ", llm_name),
      x = "Intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
    )
}
```

#2.different llms ICC
```{r}
calc_pairwise_icc_boot <- function(df, rater1, rater2, B = 1000, conf = 0.95, seed = 123) {
  dims <- unique(df$Dimension)
  
  out <- lapply(seq_along(dims), function(i) {
    d <- dims[i]
    
    tmp <- df %>%
      filter(Dimension == d)
    
    res <- boot_icc(
      x = tmp[[rater1]],
      y = tmp[[rater2]],
      B = B,
      conf = conf,
      seed = seed + i
    )
    
    data.frame(
      Dimension = d,
      Pair = paste(rater1, "vs", rater2),
      n = res$n,
      ICC = res$ICC,
      ICC_lwr = res$ICC_lwr,
      ICC_upr = res$ICC_upr
    )
  })
  
  bind_rows(out)
}
```

```{r}
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))

    labs(
      title = pair_name,
      x = "Intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC)",

      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),

      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
```

#4. HC vs MDD patterns
```{r}
calc_icc_boot_by_group <- function(df, llm_name, B = 1000, conf = 0.95, seed = 123) {
  groups <- unique(df$Group)
  dims <- unique(df$Dimension)
  
  out <- list()
  idx_count <- 0
  
  for (g in groups) {
    for (d in dims) {
      idx_count <- idx_count + 1
      
      tmp <- df %>%
        filter(Group == g, Dimension == d)
      
      res <- boot_icc(
        x = tmp$human,
        y = tmp[[llm_name]],
        B = B,
        conf = conf,
        seed = seed + idx_count
      )
      
      out[[idx_count]] <- data.frame(
        Group = as.character(g),
        Dimension = d,
        LLM = llm_name,
        n = res$n,
        ICC = res$ICC,
        ICC_lwr = res$ICC_lwr,
        ICC_upr = res$ICC_upr
      )
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}
```

```{r}
plot_group_icc_boot <- function(data, llm_name,
                                xlim = c(-0.1, 0.8),
                                highlight_cut = 0.50) {
  
  df_plot <- data %>%
    filter(LLM == llm_name) %>%
    mutate(
      Dimension = str_wrap(as.character(Dimension), width = 8)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    arrange(ICC, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      Dimension = factor(Dimension, levels = unique(Dimension)),
      Highlight = ifelse(ICC >= highlight_cut, "ICC ≥ 0.50", "ICC < 0.50")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = ICC, y = Dimension)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey82", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.45, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(xmin = ICC_lwr, xmax = ICC_upr),
      height = 0,
      linewidth = 0.7,
      color = "grey35"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = Highlight),
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.8,
      stroke = 0.35,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("ICC ≥ 0.50" = "black", "ICC < 0.50" = "white"),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = xlim,
      breaks = seq(0, 0.8, by = 0.2),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Group, nrow = 1) +
    labs(
      title = llm_name,
      subtitle = "Human–LLM agreement within HC and MDD (bootstrap ICC)",
      x = "Intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )
}
```
